chars.ABDO: ABDO: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.SARA: SARA: a young woman wearing a turquoise house kaftan with a white headscarf.
chars.CHARFA: CHARFA: a rich older woman in her sixties wearing a shiny red satin dress, a big pearl necklace, gold bracelets and large gold earrings.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a small modest Moroccan apartment living room, ABDO stands near the window whispering secretly into his phone with a guilty sneaky look, while SARA stands in the kitchen doorway behind him, arms crossed, frowning suspiciously at him. Comic awkward tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: ABDO sits alone at a cheap Moroccan street cafe table with a small glass of mint tea, turning out his empty jeans pockets, embarrassed and broke, a few coins on the table.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In front of a luxury white villa gate in Casablanca, CHARFA smiles and hands ABDO a thick envelope full of dirham banknotes; ABDO takes it shyly with wide surprised eyes.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At the front door of a small Moroccan apartment in the morning, SARA happily waves goodbye thinking her husband goes to work, while ABDO walks out with a work backpack and a forced guilty smile, sweat drop on his head.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At the open wooden door of a luxurious Moroccan villa with a marble entrance and plants, CHARFA poses glamorously in the doorway in her red satin dress, and ABDO standing outside freezes with his jaw dropped in comic shock.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside a rich Moroccan salon with velvet sofas and a chandelier, ABDO stares at CHARFA with a dazed charmed expression while she walks elegantly toward the sofa, smiling confidently.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the rich Moroccan salon, ABDO sits stiffly on the very edge of a velvet sofa, hands on his knees, nervously shaking his head as if saying no, while CHARFA sits relaxed at the other end of the sofa smiling at him and pouring mint tea.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: On the velvet sofa in the rich salon, CHARFA slides closer to ABDO with a sly knowing smirk and raised eyebrow, while ABDO leans back alarmed and sweating, eyes wide. Comic awkward moment.
